# Lambda: Capture By Value

#### Course: Learn C++ Intermediate

## Lambda: Capture By Value

This is similar to calling a function by value. Here, the actual value is copied when the lambda is created.

![Idea Emoji](data:image/png;base64,)

A basic lambda expression with capture by value looks as follows:

```cpp
int main() {

    int num_main = 100;

    // get access to num_main from the enclosing function
    auto my_lambda = [num_main] () {
        cout << num_main;
    };

   ... ... ...

    return 0;
}
```

Here, the lambda and the num_main variables have been declared inside the main() function. So, the capture clause [num_main] allows the lambda to access the num_main variable from the main() function.

More specifically, this capture clause allows the lambda to access a copy of the value of the num_main variable.

If we remove num_main from the capture clause, we will get an error since num_main cannot be accessed from the lambda body.
